title: 第三章 匠人和宗师第四章 这是好事
lines: 孟川仔细阅读着一本本传记故事，这些有的是大家族为了某位老祖宗立的传记，宣扬自家老祖宗的！有些是真的声名远播，民间自发写的传记故事。甚至最出名的一些神魔，有数十版本的传记故事。也有宗派给神魔主动写的传记。最夸张的有神魔亲自书写的，想要让后辈记得他的事迹。
“这些传记故事，主要是讲故事，对我修行有用处的，有时候一本就那么几句话。甚至一本传记故事，都没发现有用的地方。”
“而且，这些故事，有些可信度高，有些可信度低些。也需分类。”
孟川毕竟是神魔家族子弟，又经过镜湖道院系统的教导，基础很扎实，顶尖刀法都修炼到大成地步，离‘合一境’只差临门一脚。
有这样的底子……
更能从传记故事中，去分辨哪些是有用的。
“练剑不用心，只是剑之奴。练剑用心，方成剑之主。”孟川看到传记故事中北地剑皇指点后辈说过的一句话。
孟川盯着这句话，思索着：“北地剑皇，指点的后辈也是一位无漏境强者，那位后辈当时剑术至少达到了合一境。平常修炼应该算是用心了。可北地剑皇还说了这么一句话……显然，无漏境强者的剑术，在他看来，修炼依旧不够用心。”
孟川继续看着一本本神魔传记。
偶尔某位神魔留下的只言片语，甚至某个事迹，便会引起孟川的一些推测。
在普通人看来只是故事。
在有心人眼里，却能看到那些神魔们强大的一些原因。
“一招鲜，吃遍天。杀敌只要一招，只要你练出最强的一招就足够了，练那些乱七八糟的再多又有什么用。”这是一本传记故事中，三千年前一位强大神魔‘魔刀’魏冯和弟子的其中一句谈话。关于魔刀魏冯的传记故事，在东宁府市面上一共找到了十五个版本。
其中都有“一招鲜，吃遍天，杀敌只要一招，只要练出最强一招就足够了。”类似的话。
孟川同样记录下来。
除了传记故事，一些流传出来的出名的神魔家族的家训，孟川同样重视。
家训，是神魔留给后辈的，一般都是神魔认为极重要的事。
记录下的越多，孟川也是暗暗心惊。
“学其上，仅得其中；学其中，斯为下矣。和历史上最强的神魔学。这点是没错！可传记故事，都是一鳞半爪。如果本身没有足够深厚的基础，就很容易走歪了。”孟川明悟这一点，因为他看到不少家族的家训，都很重视修炼基础。
都明令，家族弟子必须进入道院，进行完整的系统修炼。
因为道院……是天下最古老的宗派‘元初山’在大周王朝每一个大城都建立的，道院的教导体系，是元初山制定的。在道院修行，才能拥有足够扎实的基础。
当然也只是教导基础，孟川的刀法离合一境只差临门一脚，道院的七年修炼，该教的都教给他了。他需要的更多是自己去摸索。
“我的基础足够，现在需要的就是最后一步突破。”
“我这一天，记录下的一条条，很多对我都有启发。”
“不过，不急。我将这些书籍都简单看一遍，再整理合并，一些修行的道理，至少三位神魔都说过，才能更值得信。”
一天又一天。
孟川搜集的越多，整合的越多。再结合镜湖道院的一些‘修行铁律’，那可是元初山定下的一些修行规矩。
二者结合，让孟川明白更多。
“好了。”
傍晚时分，孟川看着面前自己的笔记，露出笑容。
“这五天时间，比我修行五年都重要。”孟川有些激动看着面前的笔记，他对修行有了更清晰的认知。
修行第一条，基础无比重要，犹如房屋之根基，进入道院进行完整的修行，是最佳选择。
第二条，次数很重要。脑袋空想再多，也比不上去修炼上一万遍！每日拔刀万次，每日练‘血影刺’万遍，类似的话，足足十二位神魔都说过。
第三条，一招鲜，吃遍天！和第二条有相似处，杀敌真的只要一招，一招修炼到极致，比修炼十个比较厉害杀招都有用。
第四条，修炼的确艰辛，忍着艰辛咬牙去修炼，终究只是一匠人！唯有真正享受其中，痴迷其中，仔细琢磨每一招的奥秘，方成宗师。
孟川也明白了北地剑皇那句“练剑不用心，只是剑之奴。练剑用心，方成剑之主。”的真正含义，寻常修行者似乎很认真的刻苦修炼，但这还不是真的用心。真的用心……是真的享受剑法，痴迷剑法，抛却一切外物，完全沉迷其中，如此疯魔，方有大成就，方能成宗师。否则只是一个匠人罢了。
第五条，日有所进，月有所变，终有所成……
第六条……
一共九条。
都是至少三位神魔都提到过，并且以孟川的见识，也认为非常有道理的。
content_en:
Meng Chuan carefully read the biographies one after another. Some of these were biographies written by big families to promote their ancestors! Some are really famous and biographical stories written spontaneously by the people. Even some of the most famous gods and demons have dozens of versions of their biographies. There are also biographies written by sects on their own initiative for gods and demons. The most exaggerated ones were written by gods and demons themselves, hoping that future generations would remember his deeds.
"These biographical stories are mainly about telling stories and are useful for my practice. Sometimes there are only a few sentences in each one. Even in one biographical story, I have not found anything useful."
"Moreover, some of these stories have high credibility and some have low credibility. They also need to be classified."
After all, Meng Chuan is a child of the God and Demon family, and has been taught by the Jinghu Taoist Academy system. He has a solid foundation. He has practiced top sword skills to the point of mastery, and is only one step away from the 'Unity Realm'.
With such a foundation...
You can also discern which ones are useful from biographical stories.
"If you don't use your heart when practicing swords, you are just a slave of the sword. If you practice swords with your heart, you will become the master of the sword." Meng Chuan saw what the North Sword King said to his descendants in the biography.
Meng Chuan stared at these words and thought: "The Sword King of the North, the junior he taught was also a strong man in the Wu Leak Realm. The junior's swordsmanship at that time had at least reached the Unity Realm. Normal practice should be considered diligent. But the Sword King of the North also said this... Obviously, in his opinion, the swordsmanship of the Wu Leo Realm strongman is still not diligent enough."
…
Meng Chuan continued to read biographies of gods and demons.
Occasionally, a few words or even a certain deed left by a certain god or demon will lead to some speculations in Meng Chuan.
To ordinary people, it is just a story.
In the eyes of a caring person, one can see some of the reasons why those gods and demons are so powerful.
"One fresh move can be used all over the world. You only need one move to kill the enemy. As long as you practice the strongest move, it is enough. No matter how many random moves you practice, there is no use." This is one of the conversations between Wei Feng, a powerful god and demon "Demon Sword" and his disciples in a biography story three thousand years ago. Regarding the biographical story of Demon Sword Wei Feng, a total of fifteen versions have been found on the market in Dongning Prefecture.
There are words like "One fresh move can be used all over the world. It only takes one move to kill the enemy. Just practice the strongest move is enough."
Meng Chuan also recorded it.
In addition to biographical stories, Meng Chuan also attaches great importance to some family mottos of famous gods and demons families.
Family mottos are left by gods and demons to their descendants, and they are generally things that gods and demons consider extremely important.
The more records were recorded, the more Meng Chuan was secretly frightened.
"If you learn the above, you can only get the best; if you learn the above, you are the lowest. It is the strongest science of gods and demons in history. This is true! But the biographies and stories are all scratchy. If you don't have a deep enough foundation, it is easy to go astray." Meng Chuan understood this because he saw the family training of many families and attached great importance to the foundation of cultivation.
It is clearly decreed that the disciples of the family must enter the Taoist Academy and conduct complete systematic cultivation.
Because the Taoist Academy... was established by the oldest sect in the world, the Yuanchu Mountain, in every major city in the Zhou Dynasty. The teaching system of the Taoist Academy was formulated by the Yuanchu Mountain. Only by practicing in a Taoist monastery can you have a solid foundation.
Of course, it's just the basics of teaching. Meng Chuan's sword skills are just one step away from the realm of separation and union. The seven years of training in the Taoist Academy have taught him everything that needs to be taught. What he needs is more to explore on his own.
"My foundation is sufficient. What I need now is the final breakthrough."
"Everything I recorded throughout my day has inspired me a lot."
"However, there is no rush. I will briefly read these books and then sort them out. Some of the principles of practice must be said by at least three gods and demons, so that they are more trustworthy."
…
Day after day.
The more Meng Chuan collected, the more he integrated. Combined with some of the 'iron rules of practice' of Jinghu Taoist Temple, those are some practice rules set by Yuanchu Mountain.
The combination of the two made Meng Chuan understand more.
"Okay."
In the evening, Meng Chuan looked at his notes in front of him and smiled.
"These five days are more important than my five years of practice." Meng Chuan looked at the notes in front of him with excitement, and he had a clearer understanding of practice.
The first point of practice is that the foundation is extremely important, just like the foundation of a house. Entering a Taoist temple for complete practice is the best choice.
Second, the number of times is important. No matter how many thoughts you have in your head, it is nothing compared to practicing ten thousand times! Draw the sword ten thousand times a day and practice the 'Blood Shadow Stab' ten thousand times a day. Twelve gods and demons have said similar things.
Article 3: One trick can be eaten all over the world! It is similar to the second article. It really only takes one move to kill the enemy. If you practice one move to the extreme, it will be more effective than practicing ten more powerful killing moves.
Article 4: Cultivation is indeed hard. If you endure the hardships and grit your teeth to practice, you will only be a craftsman after all! Only by truly enjoying it, being obsessed with it, and carefully pondering the secrets of each move can you become a master.
Meng Chuan also understood the true meaning of the North Sword Emperor's words, "If you don't practice swords with your heart, you are just a slave of the sword. If you practice swords with your heart, you will become the master of the sword." Ordinary practitioners seem to practice hard and seriously, but this is not true. Only those who really put their heart into it... really enjoy the swordsmanship, become obsessed with the swordsmanship, throw away all external things, and completely indulge in it. Only those who are so crazy can achieve great achievements and become a master. Otherwise he is just a craftsman.
Article 5: The sun advances, the moon changes, and finally something is achieved...
Article 6...
…
Nine in total.
At least three gods and demons have mentioned them, and based on Meng Chuan's knowledge, they also think it is very reasonable.
title_en: Chapter 3 The Craftsman and the Master Chapter 4 This is a good thing
